content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison-plot script for the FUNWAVE-TVD conical island benchmark, case C. Loads measured data C.txt (L2; column 1 time into t L10, columns 2-5 into measure(:,1..4) L11-14) and four FUNWAVE station outputs sta_0001/sta_0002/sta_0008/sta_0013 mapped to gauges 6/9/16/22 (L3-6 comments). Applies a model time shift time_lag_case_A=22.63 to each station time series (L8, L16-25); model eta from column 2 of each station file (L17, L20, L23, L26). Gauge labels ' 6',' 9','16','22' (L28-31); fixed axes ax=[25 41 -0.06 0.1] (L32). Plots a 4-panel subplot (L34-47): measured blue solid vs model red dashed, LineWidth 1.25 (L37, L39), per-panel title 'Gauge NN' (L40), ylabel 'eta (m)' (L41), grid and common axis (L42-43), xlabel 'x (m)' on the last panel only (L44-46). Identical in structure to the work_case_B script except data file, lag value and axis limits. No functions defined.
entities: script variables: data1 @L2, data6 @L3, data9 @L4, data16 @L5, data22 @L6, time_lag_case_A @L8, t @L10, measure @L11-14, tmodel @L16/L19/L22/L25, model @L17/L20/L23/L26, gauge @L28-31, ax @L32, loop index i @L35

equations.ref: model time shift (same for L19, L22, L25)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L2-6; clf @L34; subplot @L36; plot @L37, @L39; hold on @L38; title @L40; ylabel @L41; grid @L42; axis @L43; xlabel @L45
unresolved: The time-shift variable is named time_lag_case_A=22.63 (L8) although this directory is work_case_C -- name is a leftover from the case A script; whether the value is correct for case C is not determinable from this file.
xlabel on the bottom panel reads 'x (m)' (L45) though the horizontal axis is time; likely a label error.
Station-to-gauge mapping (sta_0001->6, sta_0002->9, sta_0008->16, sta_0013->22, L3-6) depends on the benchmark input layout not present in this file.
